_readme: Entirely fictional dev/test data, shaped like a real QMULATE Nazarah engagement (see archive/raw-intake/linga-waqf-case/ for the real, confidential original — NEVER copy real names, certificate/deed numbers, beneficiary or bank data into this file). Structure mirrors reality: Client (family) -> Waqif(s) -> Endowment/Waqf(s) -> {trusteeship deed, assets, expropriations, beneficiaries+UBO, financial transactions (revenue/expenses), distributions, Nazir fee}. All names, IDs, and numbers below are invented. THE FAMILY TREE IS INVENTED TOO: since S4/E3 every family beneficiary carries a `parentId` edge and a `lineageLink` (ADR-0009 / R6 / R-FRONTIER). `parentId: null` means A CHILD OF THE WAQIF, never 'unknown'. `lineageLink` is the zuhur/butun ELIGIBILITY FACT read for one computation only — it is NEVER a person's gender and must never be rendered as one. SINCE S4/E3 CLOSE-OUT: (1) `assets[].status` is OPTIONAL and its vocabulary is CLOSED to the product owner's list of 2026-08-16 (D-A) — active | fully_rented | partially_rented | vacant, absent meaning active. EXPROPRIATED and SUBSTITUTED_ISTIBDAL are RESERVED and this fixture may NOT name one: the seed writes on INSERT, which `asset_identity_guard` does not gate, so seeding a reserved state would manufacture a disposal no approval ever authorised. The three rows that do state a status agree with the fixture's own ledger — asset-002 FULLY_RENTED (rev-001 is its rent), asset-003 FULLY_RENTED since S5/E4 (rev-003 is its rent; it was VACANT while waqf-002 had no revenue row at all), asset-004 PARTIALLY_RENTED (rev-002 is its rent while task-008 chases a vacant unit in the same tower). (2) `waqf-005` is an INTAKE-STATE endowment whose maal al-waqf clause has NOT been read (`reversionClauseCaptured: false`); see its own conditionSummary for why the two kinds of null are not the same thing. SINCE S4/E3 CLOSE-OUT ROUND 2 (AV-1): every endowment also states `reversionClauseCapturedDate` — REQUIRED KEY, NULLABLE VALUE, non-null EXACTLY when `reversionClauseCaptured` is true. Reading a deed's maal al-waqf clause is an ACT performed by somebody on a day, and the database now refuses the flag without its date (CHECK `waqf_reversion_recorded_at_pairs_with_capture`) because a half-saved intake form used to record, permanently and irreversibly, that the founder named no ultimate taker. 2025-04-20 (1446-10-22 AH) is INVENTED, like every other date here, and is when QMULATE is imagined to have transcribed the four deeds it read at intake; waqf-005 arrived later and its clause is still unread, so its value is null and must stay null. SINCE S5/E4 (the FIXTURE_DELTA_REQUIRED pay-down): (1) waqf-003 is RE-TYPED public_charitable — it was recorded `joint`, and a JOINT waqf is a shape the engine refuses (ADR-0009 R5: a waqf is either khayri or dhurri, never both; register item #11: al-waqf al-mushtarak is an Authority OVERSIGHT CATEGORY, not a hybrid endowment). Its cohort is now three charitable jihas (ben-006, ben-306, ben-307) at the deed's fixed 40/30/30. `joint` DELIBERATELY REMAINS in schema.prisma's WaqfType and in the seed mapper's vocabulary — a refused value, not a deleted one (ADR-0004: refuse, do not remap; removing it is a migration owed to a later epic, taken only on the owner's ask). (2) waqf-005 now carries the SIXTEEN-member, three-generation, four-branch lineage tree ben-201…ben-216, mirroring the engine's worked-example tree record for record (edges, links, vital statuses, unequal deed weights, the two cross-border members) so the seeded registry can finally show a real LINEAGE_CONTINUATION family tree. Its maal clause stays UNREAD, so a distribution run against it still refuses at the mapping boundary — the tree is registry data, and capturing the clause is a write-once act no repeatable test may spend on seeded data (the V-E3-04 lesson). (3) every beneficiary now states `residency` (EXPLICIT because a defaulted 'domestic' silently routes a cross-border payment as domestic — BR-511), `category` (null unless captured; ben-009's null is the CATEGORY_NOT_CAPTURED gate's deliberate subject), `disbursingEntity` (ben-006 licensed; ben-306 UNLICENSED and ben-307 EXPIRED — the two ENTITY_UNLICENSED shapes), and a top-level `bankingRefForProceeds` (a non-UBO paid line needs a payment target; null on the deceased, the unenumerated category, and dissolved cases). (4) every waqf now states its deed's `maintenanceRule`, `nazirFee` basis (null = THE DEED IS SILENT, which is a recorded fact — waqf-002's null is the AUTHORITY_FEE_DETERMINATION_PENDING subject) and `disbursementSchedule` (null = no schedule set, which is what makes the statutory post-FYE window bind). (5) revenue gains rev-003 (waqf-002's first revenue row, so Example B has a row behind it and FAKE-ACCT-W2 exists) and rev-004 — the fixture's first CAPITAL receipt (expropriation compensation on exp-001's taking; corpus, NEVER distributable, Binding rule 1). ⚠ `disbursingEntity`, top-level `bankingRefForProceeds`, `maintenanceRule`, waqf-level `nazirFee` and `disbursementSchedule` are VALIDATED FIXTURE DATA: the deed-term trio feeds the structured Shart at seed time; the two beneficiary payment-side fields have NO Beneficiary columns yet and are owed their homes by E5/E6 — recorded here so those epics wire data instead of inventing it. SINCE S7 (the run-lifecycle slice): (1) revenue gains rev-005 — waqf-001's FIRST AND ONLY CAPITAL receipt (istibdal proceeds; corpus, NEVER distributable, Binding rule 1). It exists because V-1/G-9 runs on waqf-001 and rev-004 sits on waqf-003, so a waqf-001 run excluded rev-004 by ENDOWMENT SCOPE before its class was ever read — the right refusal for the wrong reason. rev-005 is in-endowment, in-period and on the same asset as rev-001's rent, so only its CLASS can explain its exclusion. Its own `note` records the amount and date derivations and the one thing this fixture still cannot express: the originating istibdal ACT, because SUBSTITUTED_ISTIBDAL stays a reserved asset status (above) and no waqf-001 istibdal record exists. SINCE S11-1 (the anchor input field — owner ruling 2026-08-31, 9f3d8fd; editable per f57e13d): (1) every waqf states `registrationAnchor` — REQUIRED KEY, NULLABLE VALUE — the REGISTER_30BD clock-start as RECORDED OPERATOR INPUT with its KIND (waqf_documentation_date | regulation_effective_date; the owner's dropdown). `null` = nobody has recorded it, and the engine refuses REGISTER_30BD for that endowment BY NAME — blank means CANNOT COMPUTE, never 'no deadline'. ⚠ `registrationDate` is the registration ITSELF and is NOT this anchor. TWO are recorded, deliberately in two different states: waqf-001 IN coverage (its REGISTER_30BD Deadline is SEEDED, computed through the engine, and is overdue by construction — see its _note) and waqf-007 OUT of coverage (recorded, not computable; no Deadline row). The other four are null. ⚠ There is NO on-track REGISTER_30BD subject and there cannot honestly be one on this fixture: every endowment predates the (invented) regulation date, so the only coherent kind is the ONE regulation-effective date, which is overdue for all of them; the healthy on-track subject is item 2's, from UPDATE_15BD's certificate arm. ⚠ COVERAGE FINDING: the calendar the engine can answer for begins at the FIRST seeded holiday (2026-02-22), not at the seed's declared coverage constant (2026-01-01) — an anchor in Jan–Feb 2026 is uncomputable although the constant says otherwise. (2) `expropriations[].istibdal.completedDate` — REQUIRED KEY, NULLABLE VALUE — the ISTIBDAL_10BD anchor; exp-001's is null (the substitution is pending), so that rule refuses by name for it and no Deadline row exists for ISTIBDAL_10BD. LICENSE_RENEWAL stays routed (no model yet). So the seeded `deadline` table holds exactly FOUR rows, every one computed THROUGH THE ENGINE from a recorded date, never hand-typed (S11 item 2a corrected this sentence, which had said ONE): REGISTER_30BD on waqf-001 (open, overdue by construction), REGISTER_30BD on waqf-002 (DISCHARGED — MET on 2026-04-20, the healthy registration row), REGISTER_30BD on waqf-004 (open — the seated WRITE E2E journey discharges it), and UPDATE_15BD on waqf-003 (the certificate arm: expired certificate, duty raised by the sweep on 2026-04-05, due 2026-06-09 — THE OVERDUE AUTHORITY UPDATE E10's exit names, the red board). What generates them: `registrationAnchor` + `registrationAnchor.discharge`, and `certificate.updateDutyRaisedOn`. FORMATTING CONVENTION: every record in this file is ONE LINE, for greppability — do NOT run a formatter over it (`.prettierignore` excludes `data/fixtures/`; an explicit prettier pass exploded this file to +1076 lines on 2026-09-02 and buried an eight-line change).

gate01._note: S12-3 — INVENTED clearance dates on a fictional endowment: the fixture’s fully-onboarded waqf (it carries a distribution and filings, both of which Gate 02 gates).

registrationAnchor._note: S11-1 — the IN-COVERAGE clock-start, §09's own case: the regulation-effective date, where the endowment predates the regulation. ⚠ 2026-03-01 is INVENTED and is NOT the real regulation's effective date — inventing one would be fabricating a regulatory figure (binding rule 3). ⚠ It was first written 2026-01-15 and the seed refused it: the calendar's USABLE window begins at the FIRST seeded holiday row (2026-02-22, Founding Day 1447), not at the seed's declared 2026-01-01 — `assembleCalendar` derives coverage from the rows, and the seed mirrors it exactly. The seed computes this endowment's REGISTER_30BD deadline from this date THROUGH THE ENGINE (never a hand-typed due date): 30 KSA business days with the Eid al-Fitr block (2026-03-20…23) inside the window land in mid-April 2026, so on any real date after that the seeded row is OVERDUE BY CONSTRUCTION — the stable KPI-1 subject. That is the statute's shape for an existing endowment, not a fixture accident; the owner ruled the dates EDITABLE with the audit log as the history (f57e13d), and the discharge mechanism that would clear a satisfied duty is back with the owner.

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: Nazarah first to the waqif for life, then to the most upright of his descendants in succession; income for the maintenance and benefit of named descendants. The endowment continues along the sons' line (zuhur) only. A fixed maintenance reserve of SAR 40,000 is stipulated before any distribution; the Nazir's fee is one tenth (ushr) of revenue; the yield is distributed quarterly. No ultimate taker (maal al-waqf) is stipulated.

gate01._note: S12-3 — INVENTED; fully onboarded (distribution tests run here).

discharge._note: S11-2 — INVENTED discharge: the duty recorded as MET, on time (the due date is computed THROUGH THE ENGINE from the clock-start, mid-May 2026). The fixture's one HEALTHY registration subject. Not the owner's data — the five real dates are owed and are entered through the S11-1 field.

registrationAnchor._note: S11-2 — an INVENTED in-coverage clock-start on a fictional endowment, so the seed can carry a DISCHARGED (MET) REGISTER_30BD row. Same convention as waqf-001.

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: Usufruct to the waqif for life, then to his children and their descendants in perpetuity, through both the sons' and the daughters' lines (zuhur and butun). Five percent of revenue is reserved for maintenance before any distribution. The deed is SILENT on the Nazir's remuneration (the Authority determines it — AUTHORITY_FEE_DETERMINATION_PENDING) and sets no disbursement schedule, so the statutory post-fiscal-year-end window binds. No ultimate taker (maal al-waqf) is stipulated.

certificate._note: S11 item 2a — INVENTED. An EXPIRED certificate on a fictional endowment: the daily sweep is recorded as having raised GOV-REG-02 (UPDATE_15BD's certificate arm) on 2026-04-05, inside the 30-bd lead. The seed computes the deadline THROUGH THE ENGINE (expiry + 15 KSA business days = 2026-06-09, the Eid al-Adha block inside the window; the seed's own report states it) and binds it to a canonical GOV-REG-02 task — so on any real date after that the row is OVERDUE BY CONSTRUCTION: the exit's 'overdue Authority update lights the KPI red'. Not the owner's data.

gate01._note: S12-3 — INVENTED; fully onboarded (filings recorded here).

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: Income to three charitable purposes per fixed shares — general charity (40), relief of the needy (30), and education (30), all fictional. A fixed maintenance reserve of SAR 100,000 is stipulated before any distribution; the Nazir's fee is one tenth (ushr) of revenue; the yield is distributed annually. A khayri (public charitable) endowment: no bloodline, no line continuation, and no ultimate taker (maal al-waqf) — RE-TYPED in S5/E4 from the drifted 'joint' record, because a waqf is either khayri or dhurri and never both (ADR-0009 R5).

certificate._note: S11 item 2a — INVENTED. A certificate VALID until mid-2027: outside the 30-bd lead, so no update duty is raised and no Deadline row exists — the HEALTHY 'certificate valid' subject. Not the owner's data.

gate01._note: S12-3 — THE ONBOARDING SUBJECT (V-11, browser): Gate 01 cleared, Gate 02 OPEN — a filing submission and a distribution run are BLOCKED here until the clerk clears Gate 02 in the browser journey. Direct-use, so Gate 03 needs no beneficiary registry.

registrationAnchor._note: S11-2 — an INVENTED in-coverage clock-start left UNDISCHARGED on purpose: the seated WRITE E2E journey discharges it, so a fresh seed leaves this row OVERDUE by construction (due ≈ end of May 2026) and a run of that journey leaves it MET. Not the owner's data.

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: A building dedicated for direct family residence (direct benefit from the asset itself). No yield is distributed: the deed states no line continuation and POSITIVELY stipulates no maintenance reserve; it is silent on a fee basis and a schedule (nothing is distributed for either to govern); no ultimate taker (maal al-waqf) is stipulated.

gate01._note: S12-3 — ⚠ Gates 01 and 02 stated CLEARED on the fixture’s deed-terms intake subject (مآل unread). This is a FIXTURE CONVENIENCE, not a claim about a real intake: the engine suites create distribution runs on waqf-005 to prove the مآل refusals, which sit DOWNSTREAM of the gate; leaving Gate 02 open would pre-empt every one of them with ONBOARDING_GATE_NOT_CLEARED. The onboarding-state subject is waqf-004.

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: INTAKE STATE — FIXTURE-ONLY. This endowment is on the system but its deed has not been fully transcribed: nobody has yet read the maal al-waqf clause, so `reversionClauseCaptured` is FALSE and `reversion` is null. ⚠ THE TWO NULLS MEAN DIFFERENT THINGS AND THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS RECORD: on waqf-001 to waqf-004 the clause WAS read and records no ultimate taker (captured = true, kind = null); here nobody has looked (captured = false, kind = null). The distribution mapper refuses to build a run input from this endowment at all, and the Shart carries REVERSION_CLAUSE_UNREAD in its `missing` list. Added on the product owner's answer of 2026-08-16 (decisions log D-C, "yes") because all four existing endowments record the clause, so the UNREAD state had no example and could not be tested. Its maintenanceRule/nazirFee/disbursementSchedule are likewise null-as-unread, not null-as-silent — the same intake incompleteness, honestly recorded. SINCE S5/E4 it carries the sixteen-member family register ben-201…ben-216 (the registry does not wait for the clause; a distribution run does).

gate01._note: S12-3 — INVENTED; fully onboarded (the lineage sibling computes on the wire in E2E).

registrationAnchor._note: S11-1 — the OUT-OF-COVERAGE clock-start: an invented documentation date ~4 weeks before this endowment's 2015-09-10 registration, the realistic shape of a real endowment's clock-start. The seeded holidays span 2026-02-22 → 2028-09-23 (1447–1449 AH), so the anchor is RECORDED but the engine refuses to compute it (CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE) and the seed writes NO Deadline row for it. This is the third first-class display state — recorded, not computable (calendar coverage) — distinct from 'not recorded' and from 'nothing due', and it is legitimately terminal until the calendar is extended.

waqfs.waqifConditionSummary: THE COMPUTING LINEAGE SIBLING (M1-b) — FIXTURE-ONLY, entirely invented. The DEFAULT deed shape (ADR-0009 R4: lineage continuation), recorded COMPLETE so a wired distribution run over the default path can COMPUTE — the contrast to waqf-005, whose intake-state incompleteness (REVERSION_CLAUSE_UNREAD) is itself a load-bearing test subject and must never be repaired. The deed continues the sons' lines only (zuhur_only); yield is distributed per capita over the living frontier of each continued line; 10% of revenue is reserved for maintenance before anything else, the Nazir's fee is the customary ushr (10% of revenue — this deed's own rate, unverified vs primary law); distributions are quarterly. The maal al-waqf clause WAS read on 2025-04-20 and POSITIVELY records no ultimate taker (captured = true, reversion = null — R7-c: absence is a recorded deed fact, never an inference). The four-member register ben-701…ben-704 is the smallest tree that exercises both wired lineage exclusions on a computing run: one member held behind a LIVING ancestor (temporary, reverses on that ancestor's death) and one on a daughter's line this deed does not continue (permanent under this deed).

beneficiaries._note: In an 'ordered' waqf, tabaqa 2 receives only once tabaqa 1 is extinct. tabaqa 2 is ALSO the depth its parentId edge derives (ben-001 is a child of the waqif), and the two must agree — a disagreement halts the engine (TABAQA_MISMATCHES_LINEAGE_DEPTH) rather than one side winning.

A DAUGHTER of the waqif on a zuhur_only deed. She is a beneficiary in her own right — the continuation rule tests the ancestors BETWEEN her and the waqif, of which there are none. Her children would not continue the line; she does.

A DECEASED daughter of the waqif, and the first seeded record with a death certified. She exists because ben-005 is 'Branch B, butun' and a butun grandchild is a daughter's child — without her, ben-005's line terminated in nobody and the graph could not be built. `active: false` is the flag the engine reads; `deceasedDate` is the CERTIFICATION, and the two are distinct because a scope exit is not a death (open defect R7-D1 turns on exactly that). ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: she precedes ben-005 in this array because the composite parent FK is checked at INSERT, not at COMMIT. No bankingRefForProceeds: the deceased are not paid.

R-FRONTIER's seeded subject: entitled ONLY because the ancestor between this member and the waqif (ben-010) is DECEASED. Were ben-010 alive, ben-010 would hold the entitlement and this member would wait (ENTITLEMENT_HELD_BY_LIVING_ANCESTOR — a TEMPORARY exclusion that reverses on that ancestor's death, and which nothing may cache).

The CATEGORY_NOT_CAPTURED gate's only seeded subject (BR-206): a class of descendants the deed names but does not enumerate. It still carries a lineage edge, because R6 requires one on a CATEGORY_ONLY member too — the engine will not pay someone it cannot place in the tree. Its `category` is DELIBERATELY null, so a disbursement to it blocks; capturing it is E4's write path, exercised against created records, never against this row (a seeded one-shot is the V-E3-04 shape).

A charitable jiha carries NO lineage edge and NO tabaqa: it is not a descendant of the waqif. It is NOT a recorded ultimate taker either — waqf-003's deed records no maal al-waqf clause, and R7-c forbids inferring one from a charity's mere presence. Its disbursing entity is LICENSED and current — the ENTITY_UNLICENSED gate's permit arm.

ENTITY_UNLICENSED's first seeded subject: the disbursing entity is recorded UNLICENSED, so a distribution line to this jiha is WITHHELD. Added in S5/E4 with waqf-003's re-typing (the deed's 30-share relief purpose).

ENTITY_UNLICENSED's second shape: licensed, but the licence EXPIRED 2026-01-31 — a current-looking record that is stale. The two negative shapes (ben-306 unlicensed, ben-307 expired) and the permit arm (ben-006) exist together so no arm of the gate is fixture-starved (the R6-C1 lesson).

waqf-005's tree mirrors the engine worked-example tree (Examples G/G'/H) record for record. This is the DECEASED head of Branch A: his death puts his children at the frontier. Deceased members are themselves EXCLUDED (BENEFICIARY_INACTIVE) — nothing resurrects them.

The G/G' hinge: a DECEASED DAUGHTER of the waqif. Her death puts her children (ben-210, ben-211) at the frontier, and her DAUGHTER link is what a zuhur_only stipulation would then refuse to continue through — while zuhur_and_butun (this deed) pays them.

A son's DAUGHTER, entitled under BOTH stipulations — the test reads her ANCESTORS' links, never her own. PENDING with no KYC date on purpose: entitled but WITHHELD (KYC_UNVERIFIED), putting an entitlement verdict and a payability verdict on the same person.

Two dead ancestors in a row (ben-207 then ben-201) — the ancestor walk must pass through BOTH. Also the CROSS_BORDER line on a family member (BR-511): explicit residency, because a defaulted 'domestic' silently routes a cross-border payment as domestic.

Son of the deceased daughter ben-203 — the continuation stipulation's whole subject: at the frontier of his line, entitled under zuhur_and_butun (this deed), excluded BUTUN_LINE_NOT_CONTINUED under zuhur_only.
ben-210's sister — under zuhur_and_butun she and her brother are paid the identical per-head amount: once daughters' lines continue, the sexes on the path stop mattering entirely.

The product owner's sentence as a record: his father ben-204 is ALIVE, so he receives nothing (ENTITLEMENT_HELD_BY_LIVING_ANCESTOR) — a TEMPORARY exclusion that reverses the period after ben-204 dies. Nothing may render it as durable.

Blocked by his LIVING mother ben-202 (held under this deed's zuhur_and_butun; a zuhur_only deed would instead report the line break). CROSS_BORDER on purpose: an excluded line carries no gate flags and queues NO Authority notice — a gate that ran before the entitlement verdict would show here as a spurious notice.

The case that fails an implementation which stops at the parent: his father ben-214 is DEAD, but his grandfather ben-204 is ALIVE and holds the line. Excluded, blocking ancestor ben-204 — a death in the middle of a chain frees nobody while anyone above it lives.

The precedence case: ancestors are ben-210 (LIVING son) then ben-203 (DEAD daughter). Under zuhur_only the daughter-line break wins and the trace names ben-203; under zuhur_and_butun (this deed) there is no break and he is held by ben-210. The engine walks the chain ONCE and collects both facts.

waqf-007 (M1-b): a LIVING son of the waqif — at the frontier of a continued line, ENTITLED. All four waqf-007 weights are EQUAL ('25') on purpose: per capita then changes nothing, so the run raises no STIPULATED_WEIGHTS_NOT_APPLIED_PER_CAPITA flag and the milestone proof reads clean.

A LIVING daughter of the waqif on a zuhur_only deed — ENTITLED in her own right (the continuation rule tests the ancestors BETWEEN a member and the waqif, of which she has none; same shape as waqf-001's ben-003). Her children do not continue the line; she does not stop being a beneficiary.

Held behind his LIVING father ben-701 (ENTITLEMENT_HELD_BY_LIVING_ANCESTOR) — the exclusion is TEMPORARY and reverses the period after ben-701 dies; nothing may cache or render it as durable, and its statement copy is the M1-a-approved wording (which deliberately does not read as permanent).

Son of the LIVING daughter ben-702 on a zuhur_only deed: blocked BOTH by a line this deed does not continue AND by a living ancestor. The engine reports the daughter-line break (BUTUN_LINE_NOT_CONTINUED, permanent under this deed) over the temporary hold — ⚠ that precedence is ENGINEERING'S CALL, carried as TODO(surface) in resolver.ts and NOT ratified by the owner (register item #12); if the owner ever inverts it, this member's expected code and statement sentence flip.

revenue.note: waqf-002's first revenue row (S5/E4): Example B's 200,000 now has a row behind it, and FAKE-ACCT-W2 exists. asset-003's status moved vacant -> fully_rented with it, so the ledger and the occupancy status keep agreeing.

THE FIXTURE'S FIRST CAPITAL RECEIPT (S5/E4): the compensation exp-001 records as assessed, received. CORPUS, NOT INCOME (Binding rule 1) — it is blocked from every distribution waterfall, and it exists precisely so the corpus-leakage claims (AT-12, I-C1, G-9) have a seeded corpus row to prove themselves against. The istibdal replacement it funds is exp-001's pending reserved matter.

INVENTED (S7): waqf-001's ONLY capital receipt, and it exists because V-1/G-9 runs on waqf-001 while rev-004 — the fixture's other corpus row — belongs to waqf-003. A run scoped to waqf-001 drops rev-004 on the waqfId filter BEFORE receiptClass is ever consulted, so a corpus-wall proof built on it would be demonstrating ENDOWMENT SCOPING: the right refusal for the wrong reason. This row is inside waqf-001, inside Q1-2026 (dist-001's period, 2026-01-01..2026-03-31) and on asset-002 — the SAME asset rev-001's rent comes from — so its exclusion cannot be attributed to endowment, period or asset scope either. Only the CLASS is left to explain it. CORPUS, NOT INCOME (Binding rule 1; istibdal proceeds = capital is RULED, S4 owner memo Q6, so this row opens no fiqh question): it must be PASSED IN to the distribution engine so the run raises CAPITAL_RECEIPTS_EXCLUDED and names it — a corpus row filtered out before the engine becomes INVISIBLE instead of VISIBLY EXCLUDED. Date: 2026-02-17 is a Tuesday, a KSA business day (2026-02-14 is a Saturday), is not a seeded HolidayCalendar date, and collides with no other fixture date. Amount: 4,200,000 SAR is 10% of asset-002's recorded 42,000,000 valuation, so the figure traces to the fixture instead of being plucked — it is INVENTED and asserts nothing about any valuation, and it is deliberately unequal to every other waqf-001 figure (350,000 / 275,000 / 40,000 / 35,000) and to rev-004's 20,000,000, so no assertion can confuse two rows or two sums. ⚠ THE ORIGINATING ISTIBDAL IS NOT REPRESENTABLE HERE, and that is a fixture limit rather than an oversight: `assets[].status` may not name SUBSTITUTED_ISTIBDAL (see _readme — the seed writes on INSERT, which `asset_identity_guard` does not gate, so seeding a reserved state would manufacture a disposal no approval ever authorised), and no waqf-001 expropriation/istibdal record exists. asset-002 therefore stays fully_rented while carrying substitution proceeds — the same preserved intermediate state as rev-004, whose istibdal is still pending_authority_permission with a null replacementAssetId. Recorded, not repaired.

waqf-007's one income receipt (M1-b): rent, INCOME at entry (Binding rule 1 classification is DATA, not a mapper decision). 400,000 is chosen so the deed's own waterfall lands on round figures — reserve 10% of revenue = 40,000, operating 0, ushr 10% of revenue = 40,000, distributable 320,000 → two entitled frontier heads at 160,000.00 each, share 50.000000, residual 0. Deliberately unequal to every other seeded amount so no assertion can confuse two rows.

bankAccounts._note: S12-3 — INVENTED: waqf-004’s dedicated account, OPENED at onboarding and not yet used (no movements). Gate 02’s one mechanical prerequisite (a dedicated account, BR-501) is satisfiable here so the browser journey can clear the gate.

nazirFees.source: waqf_deed (customary ushr) — not a regulatory rate

Calculate and distribute quarterly yield to beneficiaries
Prepare annual financial statement for small waqf
Update waqf registration data with the General Authority for Awqaf
Obtain Authority permission and notify substitution within 10 business days
Inspect vacant commercial unit and initiate leasing
Adopt and file the endowment's internal bylaws
